description: All remaining pages: Services overview, 6 service detail pages (via shared template), About, Contact (with live form + API route), Book-a-Test (multi-step wizard + API route), Quality, Professionals, Resources (with FAQ accordion). Depends on FEAT-001 for AnimatedSection, SectionHeading gradientWord, BookingCTASection, and other shared section components. Each page is independent of the others within this FEAT — they share only the template pattern.
steps: 1. Create components/services/ServicesHero.tsx as 'use client'. Page hero for /services. SectionContainer bg-bg-primary + radial glow overlay. SectionHeading eyebrow='Our Services', headline='Comprehensive diagnostics for every clinical need', gradientWord='diagnostics', subheadline from services overview description. AnimatedSection wrapper.

2. Create components/services/ServicesGrid.tsx as 'use client'. Import services (all 6) from '@/data/services'. grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-8. Each card: AnimatedSection delay={i*0.08}. Card: Link href={`/services/${service.slug}`} block. Inner div: bg-bg-elevated border border-white/8 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:border-accent-blue/30 transition-all duration-300 group cursor-pointer. Top gradient bar: h-1 w-full bg-gradient-science. Content p-8. Badge variant='science' for service.shortName. H3: text-heading-md font-semibold text-white group-hover:text-accent-cyan transition-colors mb-2. Tagline: text-body-sm text-accent-cyan mb-4. Short description: text-body-md text-text-secondary mb-6. Sub-service count: '{service.subServices?.length} diagnostic areas' text-sm text-text-muted. Arrow row: ArrowRight from lucide-react at bottom, className='text-accent-blue group-hover:text-accent-cyan transition-colors'.
3. Replace app/services/page.tsx: import ServicesHero, ServicesGrid, FinalCTASection. Render in order. Keep Metadata at top.

4. Create components/services/ServicePageTemplate.tsx as 'use client'. Props: service: ServiceCategory (from @/types). Sections: (a) Hero — full-width bg-bg-primary + radial glow, SectionContainer, SectionHeading with eyebrow=service.shortName, headline=service.tagline, gradientWord (last word of tagline), sub=service.shortDescription, AnimatedSection. (b) Description — bg-bg-secondary, SectionContainer width='narrow', p tag with service.fullDescription text-body-lg text-text-secondary, AnimatedSection. (c) Sub-services — bg-bg-primary, SectionContainer, SectionHeading left 'Included Services', grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mt-12. Each subService card: AnimatedSection delay={i*0.1}. Card: bg-bg-elevated border border-white/8 rounded-xl p-6. Name: text-heading-md font-semibold text-white mb-3. Description: text-body-md text-text-secondary mb-4. Verified badge: subService.verified ? Badge variant='science'>Verified</Badge : Badge variant='dark'>Details Pending</Badge>. (d) 3D scene slot div — id={`3d-${service.id}`} className='relative h-80 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-bg-elevated border border-white/8 my-0' with a centered placeholder text 'Interactive 3D visualization — loading…' visible before FEAT-003 wires it. (e) CTA: import BookingCTASection from '@/components/sections/BookingCTASection', render at bottom.

5. Replace all 6 service detail pages with identical pattern. Each file: import Metadata, getServiceById from '@/data/services', ServicePageTemplate from '@/components/services/ServicePageTemplate'. Call getServiceById with the service ID. If null, call notFound() from 'next/navigation'. Pass service to ServicePageTemplate. Files: app/services/laboratory/page.tsx, app/services/imaging/page.tsx, app/services/screening/page.tsx, app/services/specialized/page.tsx, app/services/corporate/page.tsx, app/services/home-collection/page.tsx.

6. Create components/sections/AboutHeroSection.tsx as 'use client'. Import brand from '@/data/content'. bg-bg-primary + radial glow. SectionContainer width='content'. Centered. AnimatedSection. SectionHeading centered eyebrow='About Labville' headline='Diagnostics built on precision, access and care' gradientWord='Diagnostics' subheadline=brand.mission.

7. Create components/sections/MissionValuesSection.tsx as 'use client'. Import brand, coreValues from '@/data/content'. bg-bg-secondary. SectionContainer. lg:grid lg:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-16 items-start. Left column: SectionHeading eyebrow='Our Mission' headline='Why Labville exists' gradientWord='Labville'. Below: p text-body-lg text-text-secondary with brand.mission. Right column: SectionHeading eyebrow='Core Values' headline='What we stand for'. Below: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mt-8. Each value card: AnimatedSection delay={i*0.07}. Card: bg-bg-elevated border border-white/8 rounded-xl p-6. Title: font-semibold text-white mb-2. Description: text-body-sm text-text-secondary.

8. Create components/sections/DiagnosticProcessSection.tsx as 'use client'. Import processSteps from '@/data/content'. bg-bg-primary section. SectionContainer. SectionHeading centered eyebrow='Sample to Result' headline='The diagnostic process, step by step' gradientWord='diagnostic'. Below: relative mt-16. Steps rendered as vertical timeline on mobile, and on desktop as grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-8 for first 4 then second row. Each step: AnimatedSection delay={index*0.07}. Step: div flex flex-col items-start. Number chip: span w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-accent-blue/15 text-accent-cyan text-eyebrow font-bold flex items-center justify-center mb-4. Title: text-sm font-semibold text-white mb-2. Description: text-body-sm text-text-secondary.
9. Replace app/about/page.tsx: import AboutHeroSection, MissionValuesSection, DiagnosticProcessSection, TrustBenefitsSection, FinalCTASection. Render in order. Keep Metadata.

10. Create app/api/contact/route.ts. Export POST handler: parse JSON body, validate it has name/email/message fields present, console.log the submission (placeholder), return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, message: 'Message received' }, { status: 200 }). Add export const runtime = 'edge'.

11. Create components/forms/ContactForm.tsx as 'use client'. Imports: useForm from 'react-hook-form', zodResolver from '@hookform/resolvers/zod', z from 'zod', Button from '@/components/ui/Button'. Schema: z.object({ name: z.string().min(2,'Name required'), email: z.string().email('Valid email required'), phone: z.string().min(7,'Phone required'), subject: z.string().min(3,'Subject required'), message: z.string().min(10,'Please write at least 10 characters') }). Type: z.infer<typeof schema>. useForm with zodResolver. State: useState<'idle'|'submitting'|'success'|'error'>('idle'). onSubmit: fetch('/api/contact', { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify(data) }) then setStatus('success') on ok. Field wrapper: div className='flex flex-col gap-1.5 mb-6'. Label: label className='text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary'. Input/Textarea classes: 'w-full bg-bg-elevated border border-white/12 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder:text-text-muted focus:border-accent-blue/60 focus:outline-none transition-colors'. Error: p className='text-red-400 text-sm'. Subject is a select with options: General Inquiry, Book a Test, Corporate Health, Home Collection, Careers, Other. Submit: Button variant='science' size='lg' fullWidth disabled={status==='submitting'} children={status==='submitting' ? 'Sending…' : 'Send Message'}. Success state: replace form with div showing green checkmark icon (CheckCircle from lucide-react text-accent-cyan) and thank-you message.

12. Replace app/contact/page.tsx: keep Metadata. Import ContactForm, contact from '@/data/navigation'. Layout: div pt-[72px]. Hero section: SectionContainer, SectionHeading eyebrow='Contact' headline='Get in touch'. Two-column grid below (md:grid-cols-2 gap-12). Left: contact info cards (phone, email, address, opening hours placeholder). Right: ContactForm. Below both columns: map placeholder div.

13. Create app/api/booking/route.ts. Same pattern as contact route. Returns { ok: true, reference: random 8-char uppercase alphanumeric generated via Array.from({length:8}, ...).join('') }. runtime = 'edge'.

14. Create components/forms/BookingWizard.tsx as 'use client'. Import services, useForm, zodResolver, z, Button, Badge. State: BookingState (from @/types) initialized with step:1, all nulls. Step progress bar at top: map steps 1-6, pill = w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold — active bg-accent-blue text-white, completed bg-accent-cyan/30 text-accent-cyan, pending bg-white/10 text-text-muted. Steps: (1) Service category — grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 of service cards, click sets serviceCategory and advances to step 2. (2) Collection method — two large cards ('Visit Centre' / 'Home Collection'), click sets collectionMethod and advances. (3) Preferred date — input[type=date] min=today, Next button. (4) Preferred time — 6 time slot buttons (8am, 10am, 12pm, 2pm, 4pm, 6pm), click sets preferredTime and advances. (5) Contact info — useForm, zod ContactInfo schema (name min 2, email, phone min 7, notes optional), Next only enabled when form valid. (6) Review — summary card showing all selections, Edit buttons per section, Confirm button that calls fetch('/api/booking') and advances to confirmation. (7) Confirmation — shows booking reference, success icon, next-steps list. Back/Next navigation at bottom of each step. Selected state styling: border-accent-blue bg-accent-blue/10.

15. Replace app/book-a-test/page.tsx: import BookingWizard. Render inside div pt-[72px] SectionContainer. SectionHeading eyebrow='Book a Test' headline='Start your diagnostic journey'. BookingWizard below.

16. Replace app/quality/page.tsx: import SectionHeading, SectionContainer, TrustBenefitsSection, DiagnosticProcessSection, FinalCTASection. Build inline: Hero section with SectionHeading eyebrow='Quality & Trust' headline='Standards that define every result'. Standards section: SectionContainer bg-bg-secondary, 4 cards (Accuracy, Technology, Quality Control, Patient Safety) with placeholder content and explicit Note: '[Labville to provide certifications/accreditation details]'. Reuse TrustBenefitsSection, DiagnosticProcessSection, FinalCTASection.

17. Replace app/professionals/page.tsx: Hero SectionHeading. Referral pathway section: 4-step horizontal timeline (Request → Collection → Analysis → Report). Test directory placeholder card. CTA section linking /contact?subject=clinician.

18. Create components/sections/FAQSection.tsx as 'use client'. State: useState<number|null>(null) for openIndex. FAQs array of 8 items hardcoded (How do I prepare for a blood test? / How long do results take? / Do you offer home collection? / What forms of payment? / How do I get my results? / Can I book online? / Do I need a referral? / What is the difference between your screening packages?). Each item: div border-b border-white/8. Button: w-full flex items-center justify-between py-5 text-left text-white hover:text-accent-cyan. ChevronDown icon rotates 180 when open. Answer: AnimatePresence + motion.div initial={{ height:0, opacity:0 }} animate={{ height:'auto', opacity:1 }} exit={{ height:0, opacity:0 }} className='overflow-hidden'. Answer text: text-body-md text-text-secondary pb-5.

19. Replace app/resources/page.tsx: Hero SectionHeading eyebrow='Resources'. FAQSection. Preparation guides section: 3 cards (Blood Test Preparation / Imaging & Scan Preparation / General Test Preparation) with 4-5 bullet points each. BookingCTASection.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors after all 19 steps
/services renders ServicesHero and all 6 service cards in the grid
/services/laboratory renders hero, description, 3 sub-service cards, 3D slot div, CTA — via ServicePageTemplate
/about renders AboutHeroSection, MissionValuesSection, DiagnosticProcessSection, TrustBenefitsSection, FinalCTASection
/contact renders contact info column and ContactForm with all 5 fields; form validates; submit calls /api/contact and shows success state
/book-a-test renders BookingWizard; can navigate all 6 steps; step 5 validates contact info; confirmation shows reference
/quality renders with hero, standards cards, trust pillars, process
/professionals renders with referral pathway and test directory placeholder
/resources renders with hero, FAQ accordion (toggles open/close), prep guides, CTA
verification: npm run dev — visit /services, /services/laboratory, /about, /contact, /book-a-test, /quality, /professionals, /resources and confirm each page renders without errors
findings: All 19 steps implemented. Build compiles cleanly (TypeScript strict mode, no errors). ESLint exits 0 with no warnings. Components created: ServicesHero, ServicesGrid, ServicePageTemplate (with 6 service detail pages), AboutHeroSection, MissionValuesSection, DiagnosticProcessSection, ContactForm, BookingWizard, FAQSection. Pages updated: /services, /services/laboratory, /services/imaging, /services/screening, /services/specialized, /services/corporate, /services/home-collection, /about, /contact, /book-a-test, /quality, /professionals, /resources. API routes: /api/contact and /api/booking (both edge runtime). Note: BookingWizard step-5 form submission uses a hidden button pattern for react-hook-form integration — works correctly in browser. The 3D slot placeholders on service pages are ready for FEAT-003 wiring.
